note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task for it. Everything is single-player and offline: no online trophy, no DLC trophy and no difficulty setting stand between you and it. Guides that have played the whole list put the run at roughly 200 hours, with the 100% completion checklist as the long pole. Work the roadmap in order — story, then the checklist, then cleanup — and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first main mission of Chapter 1 — and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Nothing to prepare and nothing to watch for; just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens, right after its first main mission, What's in the Bag?. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing this guide flags as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 2; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins, after its first main mission, Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: the Coffee Break mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which several other trophies need.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops once you have played the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is also where several side questlines open up — Andy (Lucia only), Randy and his car wish list, Tyrone, and Yasmani's jewelry jobs — so take the calls and texts as they come.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final main mission, Starting From Zero. The same mission also ends the story, so the gold final-mission trophy pops alongside it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of the two golds. Complete the final main mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4. After the credits the game returns you to free roam, so the whole open world stays available for the cleanup stages.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. No side requirement — just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story beat, not a free-roam robbery, so it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks automatically when the mission is done.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It pops at the end of the mission, with no extra objective to chase.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. The airport comes back later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, but this mission trophy needs nothing beyond finishing the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the mission-name trophies; after it, the story is nearly done and free roam opens up for the long cleanup.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the second gold. After the story, the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts toward it. The requirements are forgiving — closer to 60% true completion than a real 100%: most side quests are not needed, and most collectibles are only partly needed. The full checklist runs to 35 tasks, including 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick-ups, 8 bank vaults, 33 underwater discoveries, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 flamingos, 30 of 40 races won, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's target decks, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 50 of 66 weapons found and 100 of 255 animals studied. Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can still be done in free roam after the story. Work through it from the in-game list and this gold follows.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. They come in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Mix the kinds freely to reach 250 — flying under bridges is the quickest to grind. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and marker. Note that the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the nine activity types at least once. The tracker counts fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your coverage under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, where scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most of these come up naturally from the story and the other trophies, and the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks where to find the rest. You will almost certainly finish this without trying while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges, spread across 12 shooting-range locations. The medals are not brutally hard, and the 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so this is a fixed part of the road to A Long Road rather than a side errand. Work through the ranges as you find them; a dedicated location guide lists all 12 ranges and their 42 challenges if you want to clear them in one sweep.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total across the state. The 100% checklist needs every one of them too, so this trophy comes out of the same sweep. Fly each location's races until you have a win at each of the 14; the in-game checklist and the map markers keep count of which locations are done.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each distinct race counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of replaying one favorite. The 100% checklist asks for 30 of the 40 races won, so this trophy lands on the way there. A location guide for all 40 unique races makes the sweep quick.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing challenge. The spot is marked with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him at the challenge. Fishing also counts toward the activity types for Master of None and raises your Focus stat, so it is worth doing properly rather than rushing past it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Finish one of the four arcade games — called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward (they are briefly unavailable during some story sections, but work again after the story). Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It opens automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline in Belville. Complete all five of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse) — and the trophy pops after the last one. The whole line stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline of treasure diving. It opens automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton), he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dive to the shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. There are seven shipwrecks to clear in total, in sets — after each set he calls you back to his shop and then marks more. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees, or Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable during the story but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), and everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It opens automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete his five quests in order — Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job) — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Not every side questline counts: the game does not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and similar named questlines as strangers for this trophy, even though they are side content. Confirmed strands that do count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, searching for tree effigies, and Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, and checking on Kyle), Yago (the street-race mentoring strand), and Pilot Pete (the Last Mile delivery strand) — with more strangers still being mapped. Watch the trophy's own tracker in the trophy list for your count. Every stranger strand stays available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, in which you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then hands you a list of 16 sports cars he wants — the Zorrusso itself is already delivered as part of the story, and the rest include the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus and Toros, the Buckingham Windsor Drop and Jubilee, the Ocelot Jagular, the Grotti Itali RSX, the Pfister Growler, the Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire and Banshee, and more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars for you in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street anywhere — scanning a car with the WAiNK app shows whether it is on the list, and entering one pops a delivery prompt. Deliver each car to his garage (green RK icon in the west of Vice City); a car delivered in good condition pays more. Sports cars turn up often in the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. The whole list stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is only available as Jason. It opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives you his second quest, Spin On This — shut down the labs — and the trophy pops when it is done. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts as two meditations at once, so bring your partner. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy with a missable warning: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, go back to Jason's house in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen until she says she is going to meditate, follow her out to the balcony and choose Accept. It raises the counter by one, though it is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — do it anyway to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 meditations, but this trophy needs all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Meditation Spot Locations
Beebom — All GTA 6 Meditation Spots Locations

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Start Bret Vogel's optional hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It opens some time after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (meet Bret), in Lummox County. During that first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Afterward he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map and asks you to hunt specific animals and bring them to him. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 target decks in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 15, so this trophy comes naturally out of that sweep. Exactly which animal pops this trophy is still being confirmed; keep working Bret's quests and it lands along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. A location guide lists all 18 sets if you want to plan a route. You only need 3 sets for this silver, but the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18, so card hunting is a bigger job on the road to A Long Road — this trophy is an early milestone on the way there.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone's WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, then hold R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are well over 100 to choose from — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — and any 100 count. The 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK scans too, so this silver is part of that sweep. Scan everything you pass while doing other things and the counter climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. They come in eight groups of ten and are available from the start; view and track them under Progress > Challenges, where a checkmark shows each completed one. Most complete themselves naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist — which needs 70 of the 80 — so leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges to top up to 50. You get to skip the ten hardest ones entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible once you can roam with your partner, after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. A fast sports motorcycle helps you cut through traffic and out of the search area; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves. The easiest escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you in there. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you merely leave the flashing search area. You will probably get this automatically anyway: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens large bank-vault robberies, which always trigger a 4-star wanted level and an escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — you need to keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level alive, not lose it and not let it cool off. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, and ideally get into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before police arrive, the chain may not count — hit a fourth shop and keep going until it pops. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 in the game (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes). The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it instantly, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy arrives automatically on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must down five enemies in one single use, which only lasts a few seconds, so set it up first. Buff your focus with food and drinks or a wash and shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend the focus time. Line up five enemies — criminals at a gang operation work well — and drop them quickly without missing, using an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556 assault rifle. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover and get close. It reportedly does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang enemies. Raising your Focus level makes it easier: there are four levels, checked under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. Most players reach Focus level 4 naturally and earn this along the way.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge, whose door leads directly into the plane (you can also walk in through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward onto the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it unlocks.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies themselves, marked with green icons on the map in unfogged areas. Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, and approaching a locked door offers the choice between kicking it (which trips the alarm) and using the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and be sure to destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank-vault robberies. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — slip in quickly and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that introduction, pay Yasmani — the fence from Chapter 3 — for tips about security vans: if you have not done his earlier quests yet, do those first (robbing two payday loans), then he sells van tips for $10,000 and marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; this trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, so it comes automatically. A single bank can pay up to $205,000, making this the best money-maker in the endgame.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically from the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal — That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — because tailing the security van to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck. If you want it earlier, armored trucks also drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests; Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 named areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every region that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is revealed. A guide to unfogging the map fast, including the best plane to use, makes this a short flight rather than a long drive.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running 39 illegal operations across Leonida. For this trophy, rob just one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so you will unlock it automatically on that sweep. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, in the bottom right.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you, and the trophy unlocks. A short, pleasant detour — no mission, no unlock chain, just the right drink in the right place.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. Two conditions: you can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — hack into the car with it, then drive forward through the glass. And it only works with this specific blue Banshee, not any other car; the pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are out on the street. It is a deliberate nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. Inside the alley, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not the moment you grab the third item, and you do not need to kill the enemies. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for whatever is left — the trophy is not missable and the three items do not need to be stolen in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Check each character's strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are plenty across Vice City) and always train with both characters together: hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner, and while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, doubling your progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever something you do affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable — a permanent status from sustained excessive violence, which makes police more aggressive, so avoid settling there. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this arrives passively while you work on the other trophies. If it is still short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Honest status: as of launch week this trophy's unlock method is still unconfirmed. The leading report ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, Vice City — possibly robbing that same store again later in the game, in a specific manner. It is not a story trophy and nothing in the official description gives the method away, so treat this as the one trophy to check back on: open the cited guide for the latest confirmed method rather than guessing, and try the Little Cuba payday loan store again once you are deep into free roam. This guide will be updated when the method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, and go alone. The event is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, sometimes not — if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — where pedestrians are thick on the ground, and keep moving so the kicks land in quick succession. The 60-second window is the whole challenge; a busy sidewalk does the rest.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and payday loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; you do not need to deliver it in one trip. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The state has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so the money goes quickly once you start kitting out cars and characters. This is cumulative across the whole game, not a single purchase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — there are 12 garages in total, but 4 come from the story and only the 8 purchasable ones count, costing $160,000 between them. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. A quick way to fund them is robberies, especially the higher-value ones that open in Chapters 3–4. Buying garages also matters for On the Spot, since each garage adds parking spots to register vehicles in.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages — see Little Boxes — because each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so keep expenses down by choosing cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
